scripts.check:ts: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.check: pnpm check:ts && pnpm check:rust && pnpm check:generated
scripts.check:generated: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- packages/protocol/src/generated)" || (echo "packages/protocol/src/generated is stale: run cargo test -p gritty-core and commit" && git status --short -- packages/protocol/src/generated && exit 1)
